messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @on-call (Priya) — automatic alert: KV cache evictions spiked + continuous-batching latency cliff detected for region-us-east-1. Error rate up ~6% over baseline. Link: https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/2167894321
Priya: acked — pulling graphs now. Anyone oncall nearby?
Sam: i'm up, looking at tail logs. seeing a lot of small requests triggering large KV uploads. suspect prefix cache amplification with the new microbatch_shedder_v1 config.
Priya: quick checks: top 5 tenants by evictions, current batch config, recent deploys. Sam can you paste queries?
Sam: running: `SELECT tenant, evictions, p50_latency FROM kv_metrics WHERE ts > now()-5m ORDER BY evictions DESC LIMIT 5;`
Sam: results: acme-corp (evictions 4200, p50 240ms), beta-inc (2300, p50 190ms), internal-test (800), others <500.
Lee: seeing increased continuous-batching queue length on nodes host-rtg-12..15. `netstat` shows backlog.
Priya: timeline — was there a rollout of batch tuning yesterday? ops-bot, any recent flag changes?
ops-bot: flag-change: `microbatch_shedder_v1` rolled to 100% at 2026-03-11T02:12:00Z by CI-deploy.
Nate: that matches. microbatch_shedder_v1 reduces coalescing windows aggressively; probably interacting poorly with some tenant traffic patterns.
Priya: impact: latency/p50 for affected tenants hitting product features (autocomplete, streaming) — CS might be getting tickets. Marta (CS) can you confirm if any high-priority customers raised issues?
Marta (CS): acme-corp reported ‘sluggish autocomp’ via support at 02:20. I can DM their TAM and start comms.
Priya: ok mitigation plan options — 1) rollback flag to previous value globally, 2) enable per-tenant override to throttle batching for top tenants, 3) serve fallback model variant to reduce pressure. Preference?
Sam: fastest is to toggle flag globally back to v0.7 (pre-change). That should reduce evictions quickly. I can push a staged rollback: 1% -> 10% -> 100% in ~5m steps.
Lee: agree, but consider per-tenant override for acme-corp first if we want minimal blast radius. flagsctl supports per-tenant targeting.
Priya: do global rollback but hold on full 100% until we validate acme-corp improvements. Sam start canary for acme-corp override -> then expand.
Sam: executing: `flagsctl set microbatch_shedder_v1 --tenant acme-corp --value false --target 1%`
Sam: canary applied to acme-corp 1% traffic at 02:27:30Z — monitoring.
Sam: metrics: acme-corp p50 dropped from 240ms -> 160ms after 45s. evictions down 60%.
Priya: good. bump target to 10% for acme-corp.
Sam: applied 10% at 02:29:10Z. p50 now ~120ms and stabilizing.
Marta (CS): pinged acme-corp TAM, said we are rolling a targeted config to improve perf. they appreciate quick response.
Lee: nodes backlog decreasing on host-rtg-12..15. queue length down ~40%.
Priya: escalate to global rollback but staged: start global 5% -> 25% -> 100% with checks. ops-bot, create deployment job?
ops-bot: deployment job created: job/flags-rollback-2167894321, stages [5,25,100], interval 4m, healthchecks enabled.
Sam: kicking off stage 5% at 02:32:00Z. will watch error rate & p50.
Sam: 5% done, metrics look slightly better. no errors. moving to 25% at 02:36:15Z.
Sam: 25% done, acme-corp p50 115ms, overall evictions trending down. scheduling 100% at 02:40:30Z.
Priya: hold 100% until we confirm no regression in throughput on dedicated pools. Sam any anomalies in GPU utilization?
Sam: utilization stable on CPU side; one GPU pool has slight I/O spike but within threshold. proceeding to 100% at 02:41:10Z.
Sam: rollback to v0.7 applied globally at 02:41:45Z.
Priya: monitoring for 5m. Sam get logs for nodes that previously had backlog. paste tail.
Sam: tail logs snippet:
```
[02:42:00] host-rtg-12 KVCache: eviction_loop processed 42 shards, evict_count=120
[02:42:01] host-rtg-13 BatchManager: reduced_batch_window from 12ms -> 40ms
[02:42:02] host-rtg-14 ContinuousBatch: queue_len=18 -> 6
```
Priya: looks good. Marta, please tell acme-corp we're seeing improvements and we'll keep them updated.
Marta (CS): sent update to TAM and opened follow-up ticket to monitor for 24h. they asked for a postmortem.
Priya: creating incident doc now: https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/2167894321/postmortem (draft). Adding timeline and root cause: `microbatch_shedder_v1` aggressive window interacts with bursty tenant traffic causing KV cache amplification -> evictions -> batch queuing -> p50 increase.
Nate: follow-ups: add regression test for tenant traffic patterns, add safe-limits to microbatch_shedder, and implement auto-detect per-tenant override when evictions > X.
Lee: also add real-time alert for sustained eviction delta > 2000 in 5m to avoid noisy blips.
Priya: handoff to next oncall (Sam) at 03:00 UTC. notes: rollback completed globally, acme-corp targeted fix applied earlier, monitoring healthy, CS notified. If evictions spike again, re-open and escalate to infra.
Sam: acked handoff. I'll keep watch for next 2 hours and subscribe to incident channel.
Marta (CS): will keep customer updated.
ops-bot: incident-severity updated -> Sev2 at 02:55Z; incident auto-closed checklist pending postmortem.
Priya: closing thread for now, keeping incident doc open. thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam: thx everyone.
